sources_pool.title: Clinical Note — BIDMC Hematology-Oncology, Cardiorenal & ICU Discharge Summary (MIMIC-IV #10014354): Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (Bidmc) — Multi-Admission & Icu Discharge Summary: Patient: Julian Mercer (MIMIC-IV Subject #10014354) | 20 Hospital Admissions, 4 ICU Stays | Chief Complaint: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (C91.10), decompensated cardiorenal syndrome, paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0), and hyperkalemia | Assessment And Plan: Hold lisinopril and spironolactone immediately at hospital discharge due to hyperkalemia (peak K+ 5.6 mmol/L) and acute-on-chronic renal decline (eGFR 35 mL/min/1.73m2, CKD Stage 3B). Stop simvastatin immediately and reconcile duplicate Lipitor 40 MG [atorvastatin] vs Simvastatin 20 MG lipid orders across BIDMC inpatient discharge and community primary care. Reconcile duplicate Plavix 75 MG vs Clopidogrel 75 MG antiplatelet bottles following coronary angioplasty stent surveillance. Continue cardiac pacemaker telemetry and hematology-oncology CLL follow-up.
